source_scope.shard: Project Engine autonomy, persistence, policy, checkpoint, context-compaction and capability-boundary lineage

exact_coverage_reason: Project-Frankenstein exact tree/history denominator remains unfrozen; this is valid analyzed evidence but cannot define or increase repository-wide exact Level-0 coverage.
non_overlap_basis: The current 666 workspace lists dedicated receipts for core, GWT, state/identity, safety/authority, LCME/SOMA, XENO/ClayCode, latency, Retina, Dream and Subconscious lineages, but no dedicated Project Engine autonomy/policy/checkpoint/capability lineage receipt.

findings.claim: Project Engine initially enforced project-root path confinement for model file/tool access, then a later commit deliberately removed that sandbox and accepted absolute filesystem paths while permitting broad system administration commands.
Frozen-head Project Engine retains persistent goals, entity-relation world state, policies, agent profile, traces, crash checkpoints and per-project token budgets.

A 2026-04-01 lineage added context compaction above an estimated 40k-token threshold, SSE execution visibility and persistent task files; the commit explicitly reports structural verification but insufficient API credits for complete live end-to-end verification.

In the reviewed frozen-head autonomy path, the model is instructed to execute immediately and tool calls are dispatched through _exec_tool; no mandatory check_policy or external capability-gateway call was observed immediately before each tool dispatch in the reviewed slices. This is a bounded call-path finding, not proof that no external OS/service guard exists elsewhere.
findings.falsifier: An exhaustive callgraph plus deployment/service inspection shows every privileged effect is obligatorily pre-authorized by an external immutable capability gateway or equivalent OS sandbox before _exec_tool can commit the effect.

findings.claim: The reviewed policy checker is category/string/threshold based and therefore useful as a preference/risk layer but insufficient by itself as a complete execution-authority boundary.

reuse_mapping.mechanism: crash checkpoints + time-travel traces + activity receipts
persistent goal/world/task state and tiered routing
context compaction retaining recent exchanges while compressing older tool results
deliberate removal of project sandbox for broad full-system model tool access
heuristic prompt/policy enforcement as the principal control plane

do_not_inherit_as_is: credential collection through conversational onboarding as an authority mechanism
string-matching policies as sufficient effect authorization
autonomous contact/effect execution without a mandatory external capability/commit gate
architecture_delta.current_clay_alignment: Project Engine is an architecture quarry, not a blueprint. Reusable cognition/persistence patterns should be separated from effect authority. Model output and internal policy state must remain upstream of an external capability/commit gateway with receipts, rollback and denial semantics.

earned_work_delta.reason: Material historical value is preserved, but quantified avoided-work credit is withheld pending row-level deduplication against existing safety/authority, LCME/SOMA and core architecture mappings.
